cards.answer: Amumu is a tank and support who pulls himself into enemies and stuns them. He deals magic damage to nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Dodge his bandage and spread out when he approaches your team.

cards.answer: Amumu's basic attacks apply Curse to enemies. Cursed enemies take bonus true damage when they receive magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid taking follow-up magic damage after Amumu attacks you.

cards.answer: Amumu throws a bandage that deals magic damage and stuns the first enemy hit, pulling him to them. He stores up to two charges that replenish over time.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the bandage or keep other enemy units between you and Amumu. Stay alert for another cast after he throws it.

cards.answer: Amumu toggles an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies, including damage based on their maximum health. Its damage refreshes existing Curse marks.
cards.counterplay: Move away from Amumu to leave the damaging aura.

Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

cards.priority_reason: Remaining near him allows repeated damage and keeps existing Curse marks active.
uncertainties: Wiki states that insufficient mana automatically ends the toggle and that spell shields do not block its damage.

cards.answer: Tantrum passively reduces incoming physical damage. Activating it deals magic damage to surrounding enemies. Basic attacks that hit Amumu reduce its remaining cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance to avoid the burst around him. Account for repeated basic attacks helping him use Tantrum again.

cards.answer: Amumu deals magic damage to surrounding enemies and stuns them. He also applies Curse to affected enemies.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and keep your distance from Amumu to avoid a group stun.
